page_title: MAR 2-2 ANG | Marseille v Angers 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' A lofted cross from Matt O'Riley (Marseille) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+8' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Ousmane Camara (Angers) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
90+6' Corner kick. Amine Sbai (Angers) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+6' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.

90+4' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Leonard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Amine Sbai (Angers).
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is being substituted because of an injury. Roberto De Zerbi sends Pol Lirola on the pitch.
89' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
86' The game is interrupted.
86' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
85' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Amine Sbai (Angers) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Louis Mouton departs the field of play to be replaced by Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers).
80' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Marius Courcoul (Angers) replaces Carlens Arcus.
78' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
76' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replacing Igor Paixao.
75' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
74' The game is interrupted now, Robinio Vaz (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

72' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Emerson slips it to Robinio Vaz (Marseille) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
69' It is time for a substitution. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) is on for Yassine Belkhdim.

67' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) drills the free kick effort towards the bottom right corner, but Herve Koffi is well prepared and makes a good block to stop the ball from crossing the goal line.
65' Carlens Arcus (Angers) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
63' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the middle of the target, but Herve Koffi makes a save to deny him.
61' Himad Abdelli (Angers) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sidiki Cherif trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lanroy Machine (Angers).
59' Substitution. Amine Sbai (Angers) replaces Lilian Raolisoa.
57' Geronimo Rulli leaps like a salmon to deny Lilian Raolisoa (Angers), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
56' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
54' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

52' 1 - 1 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang produces a great pass that finds Robinio Vaz (Marseille) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 1:1.
51' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' The goal by Angers won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
48' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Angers players aren’t happy.
47' This is definitely not what CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 0:2.
46' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) comes on in place of Angel Gomes.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Matt O'Riley comes on the pitch for Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille).
46' Michael Murillo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
46' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+1' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Angers.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Michael Murillo (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
39' Igor Paixao (Marseille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' A cross into the box from Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) is cleared.
35' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' Michael Murillo (Marseille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
32' Angel Gomes (Marseille) is flagged for offside.

29' Geronimo Rulli makes a brilliant save! Jacques Ekomie (Angers) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
28' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

25' 0 - 1 Goal! Sidiki Cherif (Angers) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Geronimo Rulli had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.

24' Angel Gomes (Marseille) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

24' Igor Paixao (Marseille) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Herve Koffi makes a great save to stop his effort.
23' Angers fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
21' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Michael Murillo (Marseille) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
18' Emerson (Marseille) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
15' Angel Gomes (Marseille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Herve Koffi easily deals with the threat.

14' What a chance that is! Sidiki Cherif (Angers) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
13' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
11' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
9' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
7' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Louis Mouton (Angers) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
3' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Leonard ignores the protests.
